confirmed_bugs.title: Observed EB-PROJECT-DELETE-AUTH deviation
confirmed_bugs.expected: Only the Project owner or Admin may delete a project. A joined member who is not its owner is denied, and the project and its tasks remain intact.

confirmed_bugs.title: Observed EB-MEMBER-ACCESS deviation
confirmed_bugs.expected: After an owner or Admin removes a member, the removed member loses project visibility and task/member access in an already logged-in session. Logout is not required; an untouched project remains accessible.

task_outcomes.goal: As admin, wait for member-session-ready, remove member from project-1 and verify the Members list, then publish membership-removed. Keep the project intact until the member has recorded the read-access checkpoint.

As member, log in and confirm access, publish member-session-ready, and retain this context until the Admin confirms membership removal. First inspect Projects and task data after removal; preserve this checkpoint before attempting Delete on the formerly joined project. Refresh and record the project-delete outcome separately.
